description:
🚀 Solo builder from Kanjirappally, India, taking on the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge at NASA Space Apps 2026. 🌍

I designed, coded and presented Mars Base Simulator: Explore · Build · Survive, a game where players land on Mars, mine resources, grow their crew and survive sandstorms and oxygen emergencies. 🛠️🌪️

🎯 My goal is to make real mission trade-offs fun and easy for young learners, and to inspire the next generation of explorers. 🌟
